notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your support!

Patch 1.0.1
- Added start-up tips (press tab to toggle)
- Fixed difficulty scaling over time
- tweaked island exploration chances
- Civilians names are their roles by default

if there are any questions you can contact us on Discord here: https://discord.gg/AewJXgz
